0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest, 4th in the West, coming off a loss) visit the unbeaten Houston Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest, 1st in the West, on a five-game winning streak) in the Thunder's sixth game of the season. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Houston is without Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though Houston beat Oklahoma City 112-106 in the most recent meeting on February 7, 2026, in Oklahoma City.
